Article.title: Article
Article.description: An editorial magazine article supporting draft and published statuses with full SEO metadata.

category.description: One of the six editorial magazine categories.

coverImage.description: HTTPS URL, app asset path, or compressed WebP data URI for the article cover image.

excerpt.description: Short editorial summary shown on category and homepage cards.

metaDescription.description: SEO meta description for search engines and social cards.

seoTitle.description: SEO page title override or auto-generated title.

publicationDate.description: Editorial publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Editorial workflow state: draft or published.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who created the article.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the article record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the article record was last modified.

AdSenseSettings.title: AdSenseSettings
AdSenseSettings.description: Global Google AdSense configuration and per-placement activation controls.

adsenseEnabled.description: Master switch enabling Google AdSense slots only when validly configured.

placements.description: Configurable placement slots mapped by placement key.

updatedByUid.description: Administrator UID that last updated the AdSense configuration.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last AdSense configuration update.

ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: Reader inquiry submitted through the Contact Us page.

consentAccepted.description: Explicit GDPR consent confirmation from the sender.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

BackupRecord.title: BackupRecord
BackupRecord.description: Snapshot audit log entry recording periodic editorial backups.

articleCount.description: Total articles included in the snapshot.

publishedCount.description: Published articles included in the snapshot.

draftCount.description: Draft articles included in the snapshot.

sizeBytes.description: Serialized JSON backup payload size in bytes.

createdByUid.description: Administrator UID who created the backup record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was recorded.

AppNotification.title: AppNotification
AppNotification.description: Real-time editorial or administrative notification stored in Firestore.

link.description: Optional internal app route path starting with /.

createdByUid.description: Administrator UID that created the notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notification was created.

/articles/{articleId}.description: Editorial articles collection; published articles are publicly readable, drafts and writes are restricted to verified administrators.

/siteSettings/{settingId}.description: Publicly readable non-PII site configuration (e.g. adsense placement settings) writable only by verified administrators.

/contactMessages/{messageId}.description: Write-only public contact form submissions; read/list/delete restricted to verified administrators to protect sender PII.

/admins/{uid}.description: Administrator UID allowlist documents; strictly protected against self-registration or unauthorized reads.

/backups/{backupId}.description: Periodic editorial backup metadata log restricted strictly to verified administrators.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Real-time public editorial announcements and administrator activity notifications.
